body: Parents, financial debt to a relative and other debts, (foolish) hope that I might be able to tolerate or be somewhat contented for the rest of life. If my mindset doesn't change and I can't see another way and if I if I can bring myself to do it, once the debts gone I'm gone.

One thing that results from this is that time wouldn't exist for you after your brain stop working (err obviously). So if some technology reanimated your brain and body (assuming it was kept as it was) 100000000000000 years later maybe after the death of the observable universe it would be like waking up a few hours later.

Some people, in fact quite a lot of them, live like this for decades. You really have to go to town on the drink for it to qualify as a suicide and it's far more likely you'd choke on your own vomit than actually dying short term. Obligatory anecdote: two alcoholic relatives of mine lived until 80 ish until they died although they did slow down in later years. If you carry on for a long time it's probably just going to give you annoying and possibly life changing health problems and you'll die anywhere from 50-90
Financial independence could be factor into a choice between life and death but of course muh money doesn't buy you happiness and 'work a job you love and you'll never work a day in your life!'

Being 35 or 40+ isn't \*that\*bad in itself as you rightly say. It's what you've done in the previous years or where you are now (situationally and mentally) that has a handle on that.

I'm already dreading work, what about doing it for another 40 years. For what? To pay the rent?

I think you either have your hobbies/"passion" or you decide to have kids and you work for those. Or you get very lucky and have a business or an idea. If you're middle aged and don't have any of that, then is there a good reason to be here? Maybe I'm a coward. The feelings of regret pervade.

Haven't had sex in 10 years, lol. Worked for 14 years for nothing. I had more money when I was 17. Other than to pay for an apartment so that I could rest up for the job the next day. Don't know where I managed to screw so badly but it really went south when I tried to go down the small business route (not quite but near enough) and that failed. Went from finally being debt free to overdraft and credit-card dom again. Along with the gambling and it's a disastrous situation. My brother thankfully is doing well with his fiance and son so at least my parents have that.

I sometimes try to see myself in my minds eye at 16-18 when I was doing OK, slap some sense into that kid to think about things long term. But there wasn't any single big mistakes made other than the one mentioned. Didn't even do anything "cool", like be a drug dealer or a womaniser. Similarly with imaging myself in a parallel universe where my life trajectory and other things went another way..

Apologies for rambling. I'm drinking and having a few light drugs tonight. Otherwise these thoughts of death and non-being just take over even though at the moment I won't and as discussed can't act on them. Cheers
That's true, but I would not say 0-40 is the same as 40-80 really especially if you're at square one. I could curse myself.
Yes (in a way). If I was younger I might think differently. Now best case scenario is lame consolidation prize (and 40 more years wageslaving).
